{"subject":"Predictable p99 for a multi-region data layer","body":"Hi Tom,

I see the Northwind Payments team is focused on capacity planning and on evaluating cost and latency improvements for its multi-region data layer, alongside the Kafka estate.

If tail latency is part of that evaluation, here is one data point: ScyllaDB uses a shard-per-core C++ architecture with no JVM garbage-collection pauses, so p99 latency stays predictable under load.

Would a short technical write-up on how that architecture behaves be useful for your evaluation?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s02"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_latency"],"context_fact_ids":[]}
